company.name: Seafood Souq
company.shortDescription: The Future of the Seafood Industry. Today.
company.description:
Seafood Souq is an impact-focused digital ecosystem for the global seafood market, providing trade and industry leading full supply chain traceability technology with Data/Insights. Seafood Souq operates across the globe through regional headquarters that support sourcing and sales as well as SFS Trace implementation for some of the world's leading fisheries and retail brands.

Seafood Souq’s focus on a transparent and traceable seafood industry was recognized by the United Nations and the Intergovernmental Oceanographic Commission
